scope: CPU first-service evidence with native-array prefix snapshots and materialized request-prefix identity fixtures; no writer thread, allocator, DMA, CUDA or end-to-end throughput measurement.
limitations: One-time construction, shallow inventory resets and output comparison are outside timing.
Input/issuance arrays remain independent; exact reuse checks are retained.
Within each prefix case both methods read the same unchanged snapshot addresses.
Frozen time uses a plain function without Mock call-history overhead.
Inventory scenes use controlled counts, not an observed online pending distribution.
No full on_launch, actual native allocator, DMA, CUDA, writer I/O or JCT is measured.

observed_prefix_work.semantics: Groups use the same context/epoch/first-service request. Common-prefix tokens describe prefix evidence; repeated tokens count shared matching positions, not avoided bytes, elapsed time or additional proven KV reuse. No token payload is saved.
